codeReview.summary: All described test failures are correctly fixed. The worker removed 2 tests from test_true_rlm_fidelity.py and 1 test from test_variable_mode.py that imported the deleted fleet_rlm.runtime.tools.sandbox.delegate module. test_module_registry.py and test_transcript_exports.py were rewritten to use self-registered dummy modules instead of hardcoding deleted slugs, making the tests hermetic. The worker also proactively discovered and fixed additional failures in test_api_contract_routes.py and test_db_repository.py by adding module-scoped autouse fixtures that register a stub 'reflect-and-revise' module. make test, make lint, and make typecheck all pass.

issues.description: Fixture imports ModuleOptimizationSpec, _REGISTRY, and register_module inside the fixture body, while test_db_repository.py imports them at module level. Minor inconsistency in style.

_make_spec, _dummy_factory, _dummy_converter, and _dummy_metric helpers are duplicated almost identically in test_transcript_exports.py. A shared test utility (e.g., tests/conftest.py or a test helpers module) could reduce duplication.

sharedStateObservations.observation: AGENTS.md (backend) documents that per-module optimization entrypoints live in runtime/quality/optimize_*.py and each must register a ModuleOptimizationSpec, but _MODULE_ENTRYPOINTS in module_registry.py is an empty tuple and no optimize_*.py files exist in the repository. This is documentation drift that could confuse future agents.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/fleet_rlm/AGENTS.md: 'Keep per-module optimization entrypoints in runtime/quality/optimize_*.py; each must register a ModuleOptimizationSpec in the module registry'

sharedStateObservations.observation: transcript_exports.py still contains hardcoded _TRANSCRIPT_OUTPUT_DEFAULTS and _ASSISTANT_SINKS mappings for deleted module slugs ('reflect-and-revise', 'context-selection'). Since no modules are auto-registered anymore, these defaults are unreachable dead data. A future cleanup pass should either remove them or document why they are retained.

Multiple test files across different test directories (tests/ui/server/, tests/integration/, tests/unit/integrations/) now independently register a stub 'reflect-and-revise' module in autouse fixtures. A shared conftest.py fixture at the tests root could eliminate this duplication and ensure consistency if the stub spec ever needs to change.

summary: The feature is solid and complete. All 9 described test failures are fixed, plus 6 additional related failures discovered during validation. The test rewrites are well-structured and hermetic. make test, make lint, and make typecheck all pass. Minor style inconsistencies and a small amount of duplicated helper code are noted as non-blocking.
